why: an empty box asks nothing — minChars drops it before a token is even read
a creds file that cannot parse has nothing to search with — the answer is nothing, not an error
whatever the session state — fresh, expired, offline — the answer is cards rows or nothing, and any row carries title and exec
a query answers tracks first, each with the Spotify uri behind Play
requires: S="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/omarchy/oxy-spotify.json" && test -s "$S" && T=$(jq -r '.access_token // ""' "$S" 2>/dev/null) && test -n "$T" && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 8 -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" https://api.spotify.com/v1/me)" = 200
